name: CHINA BOHAI BANK CO., LTD. Class H
summary: CHINA BOHAI BANK CO. HD1 is a commercial bank that provides a range of financial products and services, including corporate and personal banking, treasury operations, and investment banking services. Headquartered in Tianjin, China, the bank focuses on serving small and medium-sized enterprises and individual customers. The bank operates through a network of branches and sub-branches across China.
